p1.original: 菲利普·津巴多博士是美国著名心理学家，曾任美国心理学会主席，自1968年以来担任斯坦福大学的心理学系教授，现为斯坦福大学心理学系荣誉退休教授。他以斯坦福监狱实验和编写大学心理学教材而著称，被誉为“心理学的形象和声音”。《津巴多普通心理学》自出版以来始终是一本标志性的著作，第8版是其最新版本。较上一版，第8版绝不是简单的常规修正或快速更新，而是非常重要的一次更新，内容修订与增加近半，介绍了心理学领域诸多令人兴奋的新发展。例如，飞速发展的表观遗传学及其对发育、健康和精神障碍的意义；开发基于大脑的DSM-5替代品的倡议；班杜拉用于解释不道德行为的“道德推脱”理论；以及卡罗尔·德韦克发现的思维模式的惊人力量。所有的新材料都与心理学的核心概念紧密相连。
p1.en: Dr. Philip Zimbado is a prominent American psychologist who has served as President of the American Psychological Association and has been Professor of Psychology at Stanford University since 1968. He is now Professor Emeritus of the Department of Psychology at Stanford University. He is known for his experiments in Stanford prison and for his development of university psychology teaching materials, and is known as “the image and sound of psychology”. Since its publication, Zimbabwe General Psychology has been a landmark work, the eighth edition of which is the latest. Compared to the previous version, the eighth edition was not simply a routine revision or a quick update, but a very important update, with revisions and additions of nearly half, describing many exciting new developments in the area of psychology. For example, the rapid development of epigenetics and its implications for development, health and mental disorders; Initiatives to develop brain-based alternatives to DSM-5; (a) The doctrine of moral deviance used by Bandura to explain immoral behaviour; And the amazing power of the mindset that Carol Devereaux has discovered. All new materials are closely linked to the core concept of psychology.

p2.original: 毋庸置疑，《津巴多普通心理学》（第8版）不仅是最理想的普通心理学教科书之一，也是大众学习和掌握心理学核心概念的最佳入门读物，但我接受其中文版翻译任务却有些勉强且十分仓促。
p2.en: It goes without saying that Zimbabwe General Psychology (version 8) is not only one of the best general psychology textbooks, but also the best primer for popular learning and mastery of the core concept of psychology, but I accept the task of translation of the texts in it somewhat reluctantly and hastily.

p3.original: 之所以勉强，是因为2016年6月华东师范大学出版社已出版了我组织翻译的哈佛大学版《心理学》（第三版，上下册），而且市面上有诸多国外大学普通心理学教科书的中译本，包括《津巴多普通心理学》数个早先版本的中文版，以及十分畅销的《心理学与生活》。
p3.en: It was reluctant because in June 2016 the Harvard Edition of Psychology (third edition, next edition) was published by the Chinese University of Pedagogical University Press, which I organized for translation, and there are translations of books from various foreign universities on general psychology, including earlier Chinese versions of General Psychology in Zimbabwe, and very popularly sold Psychology and Life.

p4.original: 为何仓促，则是因为留给翻译工作的时间只有短短数月。人民邮电出版社普华公司心理学图书策划编辑姜珊给我发来电子邮件，说拿到了《津巴多普通心理学》（第8版）的简体中文版出版权，想请我翻译或者组织翻译，并约时间要来心理所面谈。虽说之前我与姜女士素不相识，但在征询研究团队成员的意见后，我决定还是见面谈一谈。随后，普华公司管理层和姜女士来到心理所，与我及研究团队的其他四位老师进行面谈。经过两个小时的深入沟通和交流，最终我们决定翻译这本书。分手告别时，他们表示其实来之前就已商定，谈不妥就不走！
p4.en: The reason for the hastyness is that only a few short months are left for translation. People’s Post and Telegraph Press PwC Psychological Book Program editor Kang San sent me an e-mail stating that he had the right to publish the English version of Zimbabwe General Psychology (ed. 8), asking me to translate or organize an interpreter, and to make an appointment for a psychological interview. Although I did not know Ms. Kang well before, after consulting with the members of the research team, I decided to meet and talk. Subsequently, the management of the PwC and Ms. Kang came to the psychological facility and interviewed me and four other teachers of the research team. After two hours of intensive communication and communication, we finally decided to translate the book. When they broke up, they said they had agreed before they came, and they wouldn't leave!

p5.original: 时间不等人，为了赶在2022年1月推出本书中文版，我们团队与出版社约定2021年9月30日前将经过校订并达到齐、清、定要求的翻译稿交齐。鉴于时间紧、任务重、要求高，我决定邀请13位有翻译经验且专业方向对口的年轻心理学博士加盟，其中禤宇明副研究员、周国梅教授、孙宇浩教授、刘烨副研究员、陈功香教授、刘超教授、付秋芳研究员、张航研究员、赵科副研究员都曾是我的学生，范伟教授曾是我指导的博士后，陈文锋教授曾是我组里的同事，骆宏教授和王哲副教授也与我有过合作。经过商议，该翻译团队被命名为“中国科学院心理研究所傅小兰及朋友们”。
p5.en: Time is running low. In order to launch the Chinese version of the book in January 2022, our team and publisher agreed to complete the revised and completed translations by 30 September 2021. In view of the time constraints, the heavy tasks and demands, I have decided to invite 13 young psychologists with translation experience and professional orientation to join. Among them, Vice-Researchers are Prof. Zhou Guomei, Prof. Sun Woo Ho, Associate Researcher of Liu Zhongqian, Prof. Chen Kwok-hyang, Prof. Liu, Researcher of Zhang Yi Fong, Researcher of Zhao, and Associate Researcher of Zhaoko, all of whom were my students. After Professor Van Wei was my doctor, Professor Chen Wenwing was a colleague of my team, and Professor Kao and Associate Professor Wang Zhiol worked with me. After consultation, the team was named “Fu Xiaoran and Friends of the Institute of Psychology of the Chinese Academy of Sciences”.

p6.original: 全书共14章，每位老师负责翻译书中一章，他们有亲历亲为的，也有邀请学生共同参与的。具体分工如下：
p6.en: Each teacher is responsible for the translation of one of the 14 chapters of the entire book, which is carried out by both relatives and students invited to participate. The specific division of labour is as follows:

p21.original: 在历时几个月的翻译过程中，大家在努力完成各自紧张繁重的科研和教学任务的同时，有条不紊地推进着翻译工作，反复沟通，字斟句酌，力求译文准确。2021年7月31日，我将完成了译者间第一轮互校（每章译者审校其后一章译稿）及修改后的全书14章译稿提交出版社进行审核、中耕。8月6日在线上召开了人民邮电出版社与中国科学院心理研究所傅小兰及朋友们《津巴多普通心理学》（第8版）中文简体版审稿会，译者与出版方共同讨论译稿与出版事宜。9月9日，我将完成了译者间第二轮互校（每章译者审校其前一章译稿）及修改后的译稿新版本提交出版社进行初排与校对。9月22日，各章译者将“导读”提交出版社。由刘烨负责的“术语表”和由陈功香负责的“致学生”版块，经过大家反复修改后，也在9月提交给了出版社。
p21.en: During the course of the translation process, which lasted several months, the translation process was carried out in an orderly manner, in keeping with the intense scientific and teaching tasks of each of them, in order to communicate with each other and to try to be accurate. On 31 July 2021, I will complete the first round of inter-relationships between translators (a translation of the subsequent chapter of each chapter) and the revised 14 chapters of the entire book, which will be submitted to the publisher for review and approval. On 6 August, the People's Mail and Telecommunications Press held an online conference with Fu Xiaoran and friends of the Institute of Psychology of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Zimbabwe General Psychology (8th ed.), in which translators and publishers discussed translations and publications. On 9 September, I will complete the second round of inter-relationships between translators (revision of the previous chapter of each chapter) and submit a revised version of the translation to the publisher for primary and proofreading. On 22 September, the transliterators of the chapters submitted the “guided reading” to the publisher. The glossary of terms, headed by Liu Qian, and the “to students” section, headed by Chen Kung-hyang, were also submitted to the publisher in September, after repeated revisions.

p22.original: 在此，我代表全体译者，感谢人民邮电出版社对翻译和出版《津巴多普通心理学》（第8版）中文简体版的高度重视和大力支持，感谢人民邮电出版社普华公司的盛情邀请和倾心相助。我也要感谢全体译者加班加点，克服种种困难，按时提交译稿，认真进行互校，反复修改完善，齐心协力奉献给读者一本高质量的佳作！
p22.en: On behalf of all the translators, I would like to thank the People's Post and Telecommunications Press for the great importance it attaches to the translation and publication of the Chinese version of General Psychology in Zimbabwe (version 8), and for the generous invitation and assistance extended to the PwC company by the People's Post and Telecommunications Press. I would also like to thank all the translators for their overtime, their difficulties, their timely submission, their careful mutual learning, their revision and refinement, and their collective dedication to a quality and good work for the readers!

p23.original: 我相信读者会喜欢这本书，也由衷地期待这本书给所有对心理学有兴趣的初学者带来喜悦和欢乐。读这本书，大家一定会发现，心理学很有用！
p23.en: I'm sure the readers will like the book, and I sincerely expect it to bring joy and joy to all those beginners who are interested in psychology. Read this book, you'll find psychology is useful!
